title: UPT / Higgs Quantum-Tuber Upgrade — Minimal Z2 Scalar Completion and Fractional-Kinetic Benchmark
subcategory: Higgs portal, nonlocal EFT, UPT completion
status: archive-generated mathematical completion benchmark; not evidence for a new particle or validated UPT physics
abstract: This upgrade performs the next calculation demanded by the UPT and Higgs/Quantum-Tuber records: it freezes one minimal field-content fork and carries it far enough to become a calculable benchmark. The selected benchmark is the Standard Model plus one real gauge-singlet scalar P with an exact Z2 symmetry, P -> -P. This choice is deliberately conservative: it preserves a Potato scalar and a gauge-invariant Higgs portal while avoiding unresolved U(1)_P charge assignments, anomaly questions and scalar-vector mixing. The historical U(1)_P branch is not rejected; it remains a separate completion. For the Z2 benchmark the electroweak/Potato vacuum conditions, scalar masses, portal vertices, mixed-vacuum equations, boundedness conditions and the h->PP partial width are explicit. A second layer then gives the recovered fractional kinetic idea a dimensionally consistent Euclidean EFT kernel with alpha=1.3, making its low-energy correction and its burden of Lorentzian analytic continuation explicit. The result is a baseline against which any claimed specifically UPT effect must outperform an ordinary singlet-Higgs-portal model.

selected_minimal_model.fields: Standard Model + one real scalar P with exact Z2:P->-P
selected_minimal_model.lagrangian: L = L_SM + 1/2 (partial P)^2 - V(H,P), V = -mu_H^2 H^dagger H + lambda_H(H^dagger H)^2 + (mu_P^2/2)P^2 + (lambda_P/4)P^4 + (lambda_HP/2)P^2 H^dagger H
why_this_fork: P is a genuine additional degree of freedom with the fewest new assumptions.
Every displayed renormalizable interaction is Standard-Model gauge invariant.

Exact Z2 forbids odd powers of P, removes tree-level Higgs-P mixing when

=0 and can make P stable.
It supplies a clean null model: any specifically UPT structure must improve on this ordinary scalar-singlet baseline.
selected_minimal_model.what_is_not_claimed: The benchmark does not realize the recovered U(1)_P gauge field F_P. A real scalar cannot carry a nontrivial continuous U(1) phase charge; the complex-scalar/gauge completion remains a separate branch.

local_stability_conditions: m_P,phys^2 > 0 for stability against infinitesimal P fluctuations around the Z2-symmetric electroweak vacuum
electroweak_z2_vacuum.large_field_boundedness: For the quartic form used here, copositivity requires lambda_H>0, lambda_P>0 and lambda_HP > -2 sqrt(lambda_H lambda_P). This is a tree-level large-field condition, not a full RG/vacuum-lifetime result.
electroweak_z2_vacuum.plain_language: Electroweak symmetry breaking shifts the physical P mass even when P has no vacuum expectation value. The portal coupling therefore controls both the mass bookkeeping and all leading Higgs-mediated interactions.

portal_vertices_and_decay.hpp_vertex_convention: With L_int = -(g_hPP/2) h P^2, g_hPP=lambda_HP v.
portal_vertices_and_decay.invisible_or_exotic_width: Gamma(h->PP) = lambda_HP^2 v^2/(32 pi m_h) * sqrt(1-4 m_P,phys^2/m_h^2), valid at tree level when m_P,phys < m_h/2.
portal_vertices_and_decay.interpretation: This formula turns the portal from a named coupling into a direct observable contract. If P is stable and invisible on detector scales the channel contributes to invisible Higgs width; otherwise it is an exotic Higgs decay.
portal_vertices_and_decay.baseline_note: The same expression is standard scalar-singlet Higgs-portal physics. Its existence alone is not novel evidence for UPT.

mixed_vacuum_branch.mass_matrix: M^2 = [[2 lambda_H v^2, lambda_HP v w], [lambda_HP v w, 2 lambda_P w^2]]
mixed_vacuum_branch.local_minimum_test: For v^2>0 and w^2>0 with lambda_H>0 and lambda_P>0, positive determinant of the scalar Hessian requires Delta>0. Global-vacuum selection still requires comparing the potential energy of all stationary branches.
mixed_vacuum_branch.scientific_value: The archive can now distinguish the stable Z2 branch, a mixed/broken branch and an inconsistent parameter choice instead of speaking generically about symmetry breaking.

parameter_reduction_and_identifiability.identifiability_note:
At leading collider order with

=0, many Higgs observables depend strongly on m_P and lambda_HP but not directly on lambda_P. Therefore lambda_P cannot be claimed measured from Higgs-portal production/decay alone; self-interaction, thermal history or other observables are needed.
parameter_reduction_and_identifiability.novelty_gate: UPT earns additional explanatory content only if a further recovered structure, such as the fractional kernel, Z6, or a completed U(1)_P sector, produces a quantitatively distinguishable observable while preserving consistency.

fractional_kinetic_completion.purpose: Repair the dimension of the recovered Box^alpha term and isolate it from the already-calculable local Higgs-portal baseline.
fractional_kinetic_completion.euclidean_quadratic_action: S_E,quad = 1/2 integral d^4x P [ -partial_E^2 + m_P^2 + eta Lambda^2 ((-partial_E^2)/Lambda^2)^alpha ] P

parameters.Lambda: EFT/nonlocal scale with mass dimension 1; identify Lambda approximately 1/ell only after units/conventions are frozen

fractional_kinetic_completion.dimensional_check: Lambda^2(k^2/Lambda^2)^alpha has mass dimension 2, so the quadratic operator has the same dimension as k^2 and m_P^2.
fractional_kinetic_completion.low_energy_ratio: For k^2 >> m_P^2 but k << Lambda, the fractional correction relative to the canonical k^2 term is approximately eta (k^2/Lambda^2)^(alpha-1). With alpha=1.3 this scales as eta (k/Lambda)^0.6.
fractional_kinetic_completion.correspondence_limit: eta -> 0 or k/Lambda -> 0 recovers the local singlet benchmark for alpha>1.
fractional_kinetic_completion.euclidean_stability_observation: For m_P^2>0 and eta>=0, the displayed Euclidean denominator is positive for real k^2>=0. This is only a Euclidean quadratic check; it does not prove Lorentzian unitarity, microcausality or a positive spectral density.

worked_consequences: If m_P < m_h/2, lambda_HP immediately maps to a calculable Higgs decay width; this is the cleanest first experimental handle.
If m_P > m_h/2, on-shell h->PP closes, so collider sensitivity must come from off-shell/production effects or from a mixed-vacuum branch.

For alpha=1.3 and a very high Lambda, fractional corrections decouple slowly as (k/Lambda)^0.6 compared with an integer higher-derivative term, but whether that behavior is physically admissible depends on the Lorentzian spectral prescription.
A nonzero lambda_P changes P self-interaction and vacuum structure but is not automatically visible in ordinary Higgs signal strengths on the unbroken Z2 branch.
next_calculations: Use current Higgs invisible/exotic-decay likelihoods to bound lambda_HP as a function of m_P in the Z2 branch.
Run the scalar quartics with a declared renormalization prescription and map perturbativity/vacuum stability to the EFT cutoff.
For the fractional branch, compute the Lorentzian spectral representation and determine whether the chosen alpha=1.3 prescription introduces unacceptable states.
Only after the neutral benchmark is controlled should the archive compare it quantitatively with the complex U(1)_P fork.

validation.status: internally derived from a declared minimal model; not empirically validated
validation.falsifiability: The benchmark can be rejected in parameter regions with no acceptable vacuum, nonperturbative/inconsistent evolution below the claimed cutoff, or conflict with the observables computed from the same Lagrangian. A specifically UPT claim is downgraded if the fractional or symmetry additions produce no reproducible improvement over the ordinary singlet baseline.
